text:
Period 3 of the Periodic Table contains the elements sodium to argon.
Which statement about the elements is correct?
A
Na and Mg are poor conductors of electricity.
B
Na and Mg react with acids to make hydrogen.
S and Cl are malleable and ductile.
C
S and Cl have the highest melting and boiling points.
D

options.label: A
options.text: Na and Mg are poor conductors of electricity.

options.label: B
options.text: Na and Mg react with acids to make hydrogen.

options.label: C
options.text: S and Cl are malleable and ductile.

options.label: D
options.text: S and Cl have the highest melting and boiling points.
